"''Where?''"
"''Long-range sensors indicate Castilon.|The pilot and Tierny, on the ''Thunderer''|audio=FOSpecialForcesPilot-TheEscape.flac|}} A [[human]] [[First Order Special Forces]] '''pilot''' served on the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]'',''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' reporting directly to the [[Starship|vessel's]] [[Commanding officer|commanders]].{{Databank|first-order-tie-fighter-pilots|First Order TIE Fighter Pilots}} In [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|2|18}} after [[Lieutenant]] [[Tamara Ryvora]]'s [[Galek's TIE fighter squadron|squadron]] had [[Hyperspace|jumped]] from their [[star system]] for supposed training, the [[First Order]] [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|pilot]] went to the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] and notified [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] and [[Agent]] [[Tierny]] of the unit's departure. When Tierny asked for the [[squadron]]'s whereabouts, the [[pilot]] replied that long-range [[sensor]]s indicated the unit had traveled to the [[Castilon system]]. The pilot wore a [[Color|black]] [[First Order TIE fighter pilot helmet|flight helmet]] bearing the signature red markings denoting their status as a member of the First Order [[Special forces|Special Forces]].''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' They also donned a black [[First Order TIE pilot flight suit|vac-suit]] with [[life support]] equipment installed as well as black [[boot]]s. ==Behind the scenes== The pilot first appeared in part one of the two-part episode "[[The Escape (episode)|The Escape]]," the finale of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[January 26]], [[2020]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} Their voice actor was uncredited in the episode. Concept art was created for the pilot by [[Lucasfilm Animation]] artist [[Colas Gauthier]] on [[October 25]], [[2018]]. Their model was sourced from "pilotTieA" with the addition of red stripes on the [[helmet]].{{SW|url=the-escape-part-2-concept-art-gallery|text="The Escape: Part 2" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 10}} ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' |storyboards= |concept= File:TIEPilot-ConceptArt.png|pilotTieCpt, Colas Gauthier |digital= |in-progress= }} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of unidentified First Order Special Forces pilot}} *{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-resistance/the-escape-part-2-episode-guide|text="The Escape" Part 2 Episode Guide | Star Wars Resistance}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:First Order Special Forces members]] [[Category:Humans|First Order Special Forces pilot]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Pilots]]
